title: Guide Markdown how-to conventions
lede: Guides now read as how-tos: copyable paths, screenshots between numbered steps, shortcut callouts that carry their payload, and side-by-side before/after photos. Duplicate page titles and task-list checkboxes are gone.

sections.heading: After only
sections.note: No trustworthy before PNG for this second convention pass. Captures are Cursor IDE Chromium at ~1372×1160 CSS pixels (1× PNGs), ADMIN Erik Role, dark appearance, authenticated local Preview at 127.0.0.1:3000 on 2026-09-19. The Next.js 1-issue overlay is HMR chrome, not product UI.

shots.title: Media Drive · copyable path
shots.cap: The SMB address is a one-tap copy control, not a terminal. Important stays a purple card. Step 1 starts the Finder sequence, with the screenshot as its own figure after the step.

shots.title: Photo Mechanic · How-to steps
shots.cap: Photo Mechanic is typed How-to. Phase 1 is a contiguous numbered list. Single keys and ⌘ combos are chips with no plus separators. The page title is not repeated as a Markdown h1.

shots.title: Color Correction · before/after pair
shots.cap: Two images authored in one paragraph render as a two-column before/after pair. Captions stay under each frame. The lead Markdown title that restated Color Correction 101 is stripped.

shots.title: Photo Naming · copyable patterns
shots.cap: Naming patterns are copyable strings. Field names stay ordinary inline code, not keyboard chips. The Important card carries the hyphen-separated rule.

changes.was: Server paths and rename templates lived in inline code or a terminal-styled fence, so people retyped them.
changes.now: A fenced ```copy / ```path block renders as a one-tap copy control on web and iOS. The editor toolbar inserts it with Copyable.

changes.was: Images nested inside list items, or H3s used as fake step numbers, so badges and numbering broke.
changes.now: Figures are their own block. A following 2. / 3. continues the sequence through the list start value and CSS counters.

changes.was: A Shortcut card sometimes only pointed at a table below, and iOS flattened tables inside quotes.
changes.now: Shortcut, tip, and warning cards contain the actual shortcuts and recovery copy. Keyboard chips have no plus separators.

changes.was: Several guides opened with a Markdown h1 that duplicated the page title. Video Captioning used GFM task lists. Photo Mechanic was not typed How-to.
changes.now: A matching lead h1 is stripped. Task lists are ordinary bullets. Photo Mechanic is How-to. How-to and Media Drive templates follow the same conventions.

changes.was: Paired stills stacked as separate figures with Pre/Post headings.
changes.now: Two images in one paragraph lay out as a two-column pair. Color Correction 101 has four verified pairs.
